summary: Iter46 - Admin shift edit (Manage button + ShiftEditDialog) tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 new tests pass + iter45 regression 8/8 still pass. Frontend: Manage button renders in every Gig History row, dialog opens, all 3 tabs (edit/noshow/remove) work with correct disabled/enabled state logic and admin_note persists across tab switches.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: saveTimesheet sends `admin_note: adminNote` even when adminNote is empty string. Backend treats '' as 'clear admin_note' (unsets fields). This is intentional per the code path but worth noting — switching tabs and saving from no-show would also clear admin_note unintentionally if textarea is empty. Behavior is consistent though.
Minor: WorkerDetail.jsx is 1182 lines; consider splitting AdminProfileEditor + DefaultPayCard + ApplicationStatusCard into their own files (>700 line guideline).
Minor: ShiftEditDialog uses 'view' state but is called 'tabs' in spec — UX works fine but consider Radix Tabs primitive for keyboard a11y.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Approve endpoint is /gigs/{gig_id}/requests/{acceptance_id}/approve NOT /acceptances/.../approve — easy to miss. The accept-then-approve flow for new test acceptances now lives in /app/backend/tests/test_iter46_shift_edit.py helpers.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - feature working as designed. Initial test setup hit a 404 due to using /acceptances/.../approve instead of /requests/.../approve; corrected and all 10 tests pass.
